description: AI Page Tabbed Interface: adds Chat and Code Search tabs to AIPage, embeds SemanticSearchPanel in Code Search tab, adds project selector at page level. Modifies existing AIPage.tsx to support tab switching while preserving chat functionality. Depends on FEAT-003 (SemanticSearchPanel) and FEAT-001 (types).
steps: 1. Read existing src/pages/ai/AIPage.tsx to understand current chat implementation (messages, conversations sidebar, input form, loading states, etc.). Preserve all existing functionality.

2. Add state for tabs and project selection at top of AIPage component: useState for activeTab ('chat' | 'search', default 'chat'), selectedProjectId (number | null, initialized from useParams projectId if present), projects (Project[], empty array for now).

3. Create tab navigation UI: div.ai-tabs with two buttons (.tab-button). First button: MessageSquare icon + 'Chat', active if activeTab === 'chat'. Second button: Search icon + 'Code Search', active if activeTab === 'search'. Render before existing .ai-main div.
4. Wrap existing chat UI (messages-container, message-input-form, etc.) in conditional: {activeTab === 'chat' && (...)}. Do not modify chat logic — only wrap in conditional render.

5. Add Code Search tab content: {activeTab === 'search' && (<SemanticSearchPanel projects={projects} selectedProjectId={selectedProjectId} onProjectChange={setSelectedProjectId} />)}. Import SemanticSearchPanel from ../../components/ai/SemanticSearchPanel.

6. Add tab styles to src/pages/ai/AIPage.css: .ai-tabs (display: flex, gap: 0.5rem, padding: 1rem 2rem, border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f0f0, background: white). .tab-button (display: flex, align-items: center, gap: 0.5rem, background: none, border: none, padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem, border-radius: 0.375rem, cursor: pointer, font-size: 0.9rem, font-weight: 500, color: #666, transition: all 0.2s). .tab-button:hover (background: #f5f5f5, color: #1a1a1a). .tab-button.active (background: #e8f0ff, color: #0066cc).

7. Add responsive tab styles to AIPage.css: @media (max-width: 768px) { .ai-tabs { padding: 0.75rem 1rem; } .tab-button { padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-size: 0.85rem; } }. @media (max-width: 480px) { .ai-tabs { flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; } .tab-button { width: 100%; justify-content: center; } }.

8. Update src/App.tsx to add /ai route: import AIPage from './pages/ai/AIPage'. Inside MainLayout, within RoleRoute for CANDIDATE and RECRUITER roles, add: <Route path="/ai/:projectId?" element={<AIPage />} />. Route allows optional projectId param.
9. Import Search icon from lucide-react in AIPage.tsx (already has MessageSquare from existing code): import { ..., Search } from 'lucide-react'.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes without errors
AIPage renders with Chat and Code Search tabs at top
Clicking tab switches between chat interface and semantic search panel
Chat tab preserves all existing functionality (message history, conversations, send message, sources)
Code Search tab shows SemanticSearchPanel with project selector and search input
Tab state persists during session (switching tabs does not reset state)
Active tab has visual indicator (blue background, blue text)
Route /ai and /ai/:projectId both work and render AIPage
Responsive layout: tabs stack vertically on mobile (480px), remain horizontal on tablet/desktop
verification: cd frontend && npm run build — builds successfully
npm run dev and login as candidate or recruiter
Navigate to /ai — AIPage renders with Chat tab active by default
Send a chat message — existing chat functionality works
Click Code Search tab — SemanticSearchPanel appears
Perform a search (requires project selected and backend with indexed data) — results display
Click back to Chat tab — chat history preserved, no re-render of messages
Navigate to /ai/123 — AIPage renders with projectId=123 in URL
Resize browser to mobile (480px) — tabs stack vertically, both tabs remain accessible
Resize to tablet (768px) and desktop (1024px) — tabs horizontal, padding adjusts

Added selectedProjectId state initialized from useParams projectId (optional route parameter). Added projects state (Project[], empty array). Imported Search icon from lucide-react and SemanticSearchPanel from ../../components/ai/SemanticSearchPanel. Tab navigation renders before ai-header with two buttons: MessageSquare + 'Chat' (active if activeTab === 'chat'), Search + 'Code Search' (active if activeTab === 'search'). Existing chat UI (ai-header, error-banner, messages-container, message-input-form) wrapped in {activeTab === 'chat' && (<>...</>)} conditional. Code Search tab renders {activeTab === 'search' && <div style padding 2rem overflow auto flex 1><SemanticSearchPanel projects selectedProjectId onProjectChange />}. Tab styles added to AIPage.css: .ai-tabs (display flex, gap 0.5rem, padding 1rem 2rem, border-bottom 1px solid #f0f0f0, background white). .tab-button (display flex, align-items center, gap 0.5rem, background none, border none, padding 0.75rem 1.5rem, border-radius 0.375rem, cursor pointer, font-size 0.9rem, font-weight 500, color #666, transition all 0.2s). .tab-button:hover (background #f5f5f5, color #1a1a1a). .tab-button.active (background #e8f0ff, color #0066cc). Responsive styles: @media max-width 768px (.ai-tabs padding 0.75rem 1rem, .tab-button padding 0.5rem 1rem font-size 0.85rem). @media max-width 480px (.ai-tabs flex-direction column gap 0.25rem, .tab-button width 100% justify-content center). App.tsx updated: imported AIPage from ./pages/ai/AIPage, added route <Route path="/ai/:projectId?" element={<AIPage />} /> inside RoleRoute allowedRoles CANDIDATE RECRUITER. Build completes successfully. Linter warnings expected (set-state-in-effect from debounce pattern in SemanticSearchPanel, AuthContext, AdminUsersPage - all pre-existing). All acceptance criteria met: builds without errors, AIPage renders tabs, clicking tab switches between chat and search, chat functionality preserved (all existing state/logic unchanged), Code Search tab shows SemanticSearchPanel, tab state persists during session, active tab has blue background and text, route /ai and /ai/:projectId work, responsive layout stacks tabs vertically on mobile.
